content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Retired Teachers of Govt. and Aided College/HSS below 65 years of age. Fresh Eligible Candidates. In case of non-availability of teachers, fresh candidates will be selected. For retired teachers of Govt. and Aided College/HSS, the age limit is below 65 years of age. The notice does not mention an age limit for fresh candidates or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-specific eligibility for each subject.

rows.qualification: Master Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade, and B.Ed. or equivalent degree recognized by the NCTE New Delhi, in case of B.Ed. subject.
rows.experience: Teaching experience and basic experience in computer application are considered in selection.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary in nature. The engagement continues till closure of schools for the 2026-27 session or posting of a PGT in the school, whichever is earlier. The Principal reserves the right to disengage a guest faculty by giving one month notice if their performance is not satisfactory.

rows.pay: Rs 400/- per class/lecture of 45 minutes duration, subject to a ceiling of maximum 50 classes with Rs. 20,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection shall be made through career assessment, teaching experience and basic experience in computer application. Document verification shall be held on 12 November 2026 in the office of the Principal, Govt. Higher Secondary School, Sanamada. No TA/DA shall be admissible for document verification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Govt. HSS Sanamada Guest Faculty (Arts stream)
content_sections.text: The application goes offline to the Principal, Govt. Higher Secondary School, Sanamada, Dist- Nabarangpur. It must reach the Principal on or before 10 November 2026. The notice does not specify whether the application should be sent by post or delivered by hand. It says further details can be obtained from https://nabarangpur.odisha.gov.in . Prepare the application form for engagement as Guest Faculty (Arts stream) and mention the subject. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below. Make sure the application reaches the Principal, Govt. Higher Secondary School, Sanamada, Dist- Nabarangpur on or before 10.11.2026. Attend document verification on 12.11.2026 in the office of the Principal.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Attach self-attested copies of these documents to the application form: HSC or Equivalent Certificate and Mark sheet +2 or Equivalent Certificate and Mark sheet Bachelor Degree or Equivalent Certificate and Mark sheet Master Degree or Equivalent Certificate and Mark sheet B.Ed. Degree or Equivalent certificate and Mark sheet Certificate of Computer Knowledge Experience certificate Id proof/Address Proof Any other

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Principal reserves the right to cancel part or whole of the engagement notice without assigning any reason. Applications are for empanelment as well as engagement as Guest Faculty.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Guest Faculty at Govt. HSS Sanamada?
faq.answer: The application should reach the Principal, Govt. Higher Secondary School, Sanamada on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which subjects are offered for Guest Faculty at Govt. HSS Sanamada?
faq.answer: The Arts stream subjects are Odia, English, History, Political Science, Economics and Sociology, for Higher Secondary Classes (+2).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Sanamada Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Applicants must have a Master Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade, and B.Ed. or an equivalent degree recognized by the NCTE New Delhi, in case of B.Ed. subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Govt. HSS Sanamada Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Retired teachers of Govt. and Aided College/HSS must be below 65 years of age to apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Guest Faculty at Govt. HSS Sanamada?
faq.answer: Guest faculty will be paid Rs 400/- per class of 45 minutes. The ceiling is a maximum of 50 classes, with Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How is the Sanamada Guest Faculty selection done?
faq.answer: Selection is made through career assessment, teaching experience and basic experience in computer application. Document verification follows on 12 November 2026 in the office of the Principal.

faq.question: Q7. Is TA/DA given for document verification?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA shall be admissible for document verification on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Govt. HSS Sanamada Guest Faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and lasts till closure of schools for the 2026-27 session or posting of a PGT in the school, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Can fresh candidates apply for Guest Faculty at Govt. HSS Sanamada?
faq.answer: Yes. Retired teachers of Govt. and Aided College/HSS and fresh eligible candidates may both apply. Fresh candidates will be selected in case of non-availability of teachers.
